- **Strategy Design & Multi-Seed Evaluation (Verified):**
  - **Design:** Analyzed slot-by-slot ground and air path coverage across all 16 build pads and tested iterative prototypes across independent seed batches (`101..120`, `201..225`, `301..310`, `401..430`, `501..550`, and a final 100-seed holdout `1001..1100`).
  - **Mechanics:** Combines cost-efficient dual-domain `bolt` towers (`1, 5, 15`) with high-coverage `cannon` splash zones and `flak` air-corner batteries (`12, 14`), ramps a threat-sensing `1,000`-gold reserve (`waves 8–42`) that cashes out automatically when enemies push deep, weights AoE splash shots by post-armor cluster damage + Mender/imminent-leak multipliers, and converts surplus late-game gold into Tier-3 `cannon`/`flak`/`lance` upgrades and instant cooldown-reset barrages.
  - **Measured Scores:** Held a mean of **`41.75` waves** across 100 unseen non-42 seeds (`1001..1100`, min `37.03`, max `45.93`, ~70 ms/game in JavaScriptCore). On `seed 42` (`maxTicks = 2020`), it scores **`41.33`** (`fallTick = 1673`, `83.65 s`, hash `"80329cec"`).

- **Implemented Systems & Assumptions:**
  - **Fully Implemented (`systems: "full"`, `simplifications: []`):**
    - **Board & Camera:** `24 × 14` procedural stone road, glowing cyan air lane with animated chevrons, 16 build pads, rock props, walled keep with 10 detachable crumbling wall chunks, and binary-searched `55°` perspective framing verified mathematically at `1920×1080` (`169 px` bottom clearance) and `1280×650` (`104 px` bottom clearance, keeping the full board + `>= 0.5` tile margin clear of the `90 px` bottom dock).

    - **HUD, Controls & Audio:** Canonical `#dock` and `#countdown` DOM/CSS, exact 5-state timeline machine (`COUNTDOWN`, `PLAYING`, `PAUSED`, `REFIRE_HOLD`, `ENDED`), wordless orthographic WebGL HUD pass (in-memory digit atlas + geometric wave/coin/preview/10-pip icons), and panned, rate-limited Web Audio API synthesis routed through a master gain and compressor.
